items.title: SurvivalIndex – which developer tools do AI agents choose?
items.raw_excerpt: We've been running coding agents against standardized repos with natural-language prompts — no tool names, no hints — and measuring what they actually choose. Early finding: Claude Code picks Custom/DIY in 12 of 20 categories. Not because it can't use the tools (BFCL scores suggest it can) but because it doesn't reach for them. That's a different failure mode than capability benchmarks measure. We score each tool on: agent visibility, pick rate vs Custom/DIY, cross-context breadth, expert human ratings, and implementation success rate. Tools above survival=1 persist. Below it, agents synthesize around them. Methodology is at survivalindex.org/methodology. Very curious what people think of the measurement approach, especially the human coefficient variable.

Recently, iCAR collaborated with Horizon Robotics to host the iCAR V27 & Horizon HSD Pioneer Experience Event. Leiphone's "New Auto Intelligence" was invited to experience the assisted driving capabilities of the iCAR V27, set to launch on March 13, in Beijing.

Flagship Computing Power + True Single-Stage End-to-End  
Before the actual vehicle experience, Horizon Robotics introduced the hardware and software configuration of the iCAR V27, as well as the development history of Horizon HSD.  

In terms of hardware, the iCAR V27 is equipped with the Horizon Journey 6P chip, offering a single-chip computing power of 560 TOPS, paired with 27 high-precision sensors (including LiDAR). Horizon's self-developed next-generation BPU Nash architecture is deeply optimized for real-time inference of Transformer large models, ensuring seamless synergy between the chip and algorithms. The innovative storage and control systems significantly enhance data processing efficiency, reduce system latency, and enable continuous learning. Ample computing power redundancy reserves space for long-term OTA evolution of the vehicle.  

In terms of software, Horizon HSD adopts China's first mass-produced true single-stage end-to-end system. If traditional rule-based algorithms are likened to the mechanical splicing of different control modules, the single-stage end-to-end approach achieves ultra-low latency from photon input to trajectory output. The system is 42% faster than the average human reaction time, enabling quicker responses to unexpected situations. The deeply coupled longitudinal and lateral control of the single-stage end-to-end system reduces undesirable behaviors such as light braking, hard braking, and "weaving" by over 90%, minimizing motion sickness for passengers, while improving lane changes, cornering, and obstacle avoidance.

En cuanto al hardware, el iCAR V27 está equipado con el chip Journey 6P de Horizon, con una potencia de cálculo de 560 TOPS por unidad, combinado con 27 sensores de alta precisión (incluido lidar). At the beginning of 2023, we had already decided to focus on interactive 3D content. As the founder of VAST, Song Yachen recalled the origins of the startup with unwavering conviction. In his view, the delayed widespread adoption of 3D generation is not due to unclear technological paths, but because there has yet to be a true 3D UGC platform. This is why VAST chose to start with tools and models rather than waiting for a mature platform. In his opinion, while the platform format may not yet exist, the shift in content production methods is already clear.

When meeting Song Yachen, he was sitting at his office desk having lunch. Earlier that morning, an interview had just concluded, and he took a brief break to eat a few bites before his next meeting in the afternoon. At the end of the month, he will fly to the United States to attend GDC (Game Developers Conference).

On March 5, 2026, the Yangtze River Delta (Deqing) Embodied Intelligence Data Collection Training Ground and the launch event for Boundless, the industry's first physical AI data foundation platform, hosted by WuWen Intelligence, concluded successfully at the Deqing International Conference Center. Themed "Boundless Exploration, Building the Future," the event brought together top experts and scholars in embodied intelligence, leading industry partners, representatives from renowned investment institutions, and government officials from provincial, municipal, district, and county levels. Through keynote speeches, product launches, technical sharing, roundtable discussions, and on-site visits, participants explored new pathways for breakthroughs in embodied intelligence data and its practical application.  

As a globally leading provider of physical AI data foundations, WuWen Intelligence showcased multiple core segments at the event, including guest speeches, core product launches, in-depth technical sharing, high-end roundtable forums, and on-site visits to the training ground. These segments comprehensively demonstrated WuWen Intelligence's robust technical capabilities in embodied intelligence data, forward-looking industry layout, and firm commitment to building an industrial ecosystem. Attendees also gained an immersive experience of the new possibilities in the development of the embodied intelligence industry.  

At the beginning of the event, relevant leaders from Deqing County delivered speeches, extending warm congratulations on the launch of the Boundless data foundation platform and expressing high recognition for the concept of the Yangtze River Delta (Deqing) Embodied Intelligence Data Collection Training Ground as an open, shared, and mutually beneficial industrial data infrastructure.  

Dr. Yu Kai, founder of Horizon Robotics and chief advisor of WuWen Intelligence, delivered a keynote speech titled "High-Quality Data Drives Embodied Intelligence."
excerpt_i18n.es: El 5 de marzo de 2026, el evento de lanzamiento del campo de entrenamiento para la recopilación de datos de inteligencia corporeizada en el Delta del Yangtsé (Deqing) y la primera plataforma base de datos de IA física del sector, "Sin Límites", organizado por WuWen Intelligence, concluyó con éxito en el Centro Internacional de Conferencias de Deqing. Bajo el lema "Expandir Fronteras Sin Límites, Cimentar el Futuro", la conferencia reunió a destacados expertos académicos, socios industriales líderes, representantes de reconocidas instituciones de inversión y autoridades gubernamentales de diversos niveles provinciales, municipales y locales. A través de discursos temáticos, presentaciones de productos, intercambios tecnológicos, mesas redondas y visitas in situ, se exploraron conjuntamente nuevas vías para superar los desafíos de datos en inteligencia corporeizada y su implementación práctica. Imagen: Expandir Fronteras Sin Límites, Cimentar el Futuro. Como proveedor líder mundial de bases de datos de IA física.
